The residence

Three levels around a garden and a pool

The estate runs to about 700 sqm built over three levels, on a plot of about 1,100 sqm in a quiet part of Herzliya Pituach, within walking distance of the sea and about five minutes from De Shalit Square.1

The bedrooms are planned as spacious suites, seven in all, including a very large master suite. The large living room opens to a pastoral garden and a large pool, and beside them are a cinema room, a gym, a wine cellar, a lift and a large safe room.1

A smart electrical system and underfloor heating run through the whole house, and custom carpentry was built for every bedroom and along the levels. Viewings are by appointment only.1

The location

Herzliya Pituach, five minutes from De Shalit Square

Herzliya Pituach, founded in 1925, ranks 9 of 10 on the socio-economic index and is known for villas and private houses among the largest and most expensive in Israel.9 According to the mayor, 55 ambassadors live in Herzliya.10

De Shalit Square, where Ramat Yam and Wingate streets meet, lies in the west of the neighborhood. The Sharon Hotel is about 160 m away in a straight line, and Herzliya Medical Center, a private hospital founded in 1982, about 250 m.11,12 Herzliya's seafront plan, Har/2202, includes the square and the descent to Sharon Beach in its central section.14,15

The city's beaches include Accadia, Sharon, HaKochavim, the separate beach, Zevulun and Sidna Ali.16 Apollonia National Park, with a Crusader fortress from 1241 and a first-century Roman villa, is about 1.6 km north of the square, and Arena Mall at Herzliya Marina about 1.9 km south of it.17,18

Planning

What is planned nearby

Published plans and works, and what they may mean for a buyer or tenant. Based on published reports; not a substitute for a check with the planning authority.

  • Seafront plan Har/2202 (approved)14,15

    The central section includes De Shalit Square and the descent to Sharon Beach, with beach widening through breakwaters and beach promenades. The beach south of Sharon Beach is zoned for intensive development and north of it for moderate urban development. Check the plan sheets for any promenade line or easement on the plot.

  • Land-side cliff protection39

    A plan for rock revetments and anchored netting along Herzliya's coast was approved by the local committee on 8 January 2025 and still needs Environment Ministry and coastal committee approval. Expect works and access limits along the cliff; the schedule is unknown.

  • UAE embassy, 9 Sapir Street10

    About 2.5 dunams, up to 15 floors and 15,000 sqm, including homes for the ambassador and staff; advanced by the district committee on 20 October 2025. The site is in the employment zone, not near De Shalit Square.

  • Employment zone densification11,40

    A 30-floor tower at 103 Medinat HaYehudim Street and the Gav-Yam Science Park plan (392 small apartments, up to 15 floors). Expect more residents and traffic in southern Herzliya Pituach, about 1.2 km south of the square.

  • Southwest Quarter plan Har/2200/A42

    About 1,986 dunams and 12,500 homes between Abba Eban Boulevard and the Tel Aviv boundary: long-term supply and traffic, well south of the square.

  • Green Line to Herzliya38

    The full line, including Herzliya, is expected in 2030.

Before you decide

The checks worth making

The questions a buyer at this level asks, and the documents your lawyer, appraiser and surveyor need to see.

  • What are the street address, block and parcel, and is the land privately owned and registered, or leased from the Israel Land Authority?
  • What are the registered plot area, the permitted built area, the built area on each level including the basement, and the area billed for arnona?
  • Do the building permit and completion approval cover the basement uses (cinema, wine cellar, gym), the elevator and the pool? Are there open building violations?
  • How much building right remains unused, and are there plans in preparation that affect the plot?
  • What is the surveyed distance from the plot to the coastline and to the cliff edge, and does any Har/2202 promenade line or public easement touch it?
  • What is the arnona zone, and what is the current annual arnona bill?
  • What do the pool, garden, security, electricity and elevator and smart-home maintenance contracts cost each year?
  • Is any betterment levy or development levy outstanding, and who pays it under the contract?
  • When was the house built and last renovated, who was the architect, and what warranties cover the underfloor heating, smart electrical system and elevator?
  • How large is the mamad, and does it have Home Front Command approval?
  • Which elementary, middle and high schools serve this address for 2026-27?
  • How many minutes is the walk to the nearest beach access, and which beach is it?
  • Would the owner consider a lease, and at what rent?
  • A land registry extract for the block and parcel, and an Israel Land Authority rights confirmation where relevant
  • The building permit, completion certificate and an up-to-date survey map
  • A planning information file and a check of unused building rights
  • Confirmations of no arrears on arnona, water and levies
  • Warranty and maintenance documents for the lift, underfloor heating and smart electrical system

Questions and answers

Questions worth asking

What is the price?
The price is given on direct request. For orientation, the median asking price across 15 Herzliya Pituach villas of 500 to 900 sqm on 1,000 to 1,200 sqm plots is NIS 59.2 million, or NIS 77,023 per built sqm.44
How much purchase tax would a buyer pay?
It depends on the price and the buyer. At the NIS 53.9 million scenario, for example: NIS 4,701,825 for a single home, and NIS 5,270,509 for an additional home or a foreign resident. New immigrants get no relief on a home valued above NIS 20,183,565.46,49
Can it be financed with a mortgage?
Under Bank of Israel rules, up to 75% of value for a single home, 70% for a replacement home and 50% for an investment home or a buyer who is not an Israeli citizen. Banks may be stricter.51
How far is the sea?
Within walking distance, and about five minutes from De Shalit Square. Zevulun Beach is about 750 m from the square in a straight line; the distance from the plot itself comes with the address.1,11
Which international schools are nearby?
The Walworth Barbour American International School (WBAIS) in Even Yehuda, about 11.7 km in a straight line from De Shalit Square, and Reichman University in Herzliya, about 2.9 km.35,36
How do I arrange a viewing?
Viewings are by appointment only, arranged directly with Meital Katzir.1
